title: Image of a closed subset proper over a base under a universally closed morphism
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X\to S$ and $Y\to S$ be morphisms locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism over $S$ which is universally closed [def-weil-proper-morphism]. If $Z\subseteq X$ is a closed subset proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], then $f(Z)$ is a closed subset of $Y$ and it is proper over $S$.

proof.text: Let i be the reduced induced closed immersion of Z and h = i followed by f. The composite h is universally closed, so its range W is closed and equals f(Z). For a reduced source the already-proved library theorem Scheme.Hom.ker_eq_vanishingIdeal identifies the kernel of h with the vanishing ideal of W. Thus the scheme-theoretic image is precisely the reduced induced structure used in the definition of proper-over-base. Mathlib supplies universal closedness and surjectivity of h.toImage. The composite to S is proper by the hypothesis. Descend separatedness along h.toImage using 09MQ, and universal closedness using 03GN. The closed immersion of the image into Y gives local finite type over S; the three properties give properness.

split_report.summary: Split the proof of Stacks Cohomology of Schemes Lemma 0CYQ (tag 0CYQ), part (2), into five steps. The reduced structures on Z and f(Z), the scheme-theoretic inverse image Z'' and the factorization Z -> Z'' follow the fibre-product and reduced-closed-subscheme nodes, with the reduced-source factorization cited explicitly as Schemes 0356. Z'' -> Z' uses the new Mathlib leaf for base-change stability of universal closedness (Stacks Morphisms 01W4, Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.universallyClosed_isStableUnderBaseChange at UniversallyClosed.lean:65). The closed immersion Z -> Z'' is now cited through the exact closed-immersion cancellation node for Stacks Morphisms 07RK and Mathlib IsClosedImmersion.of_comp. Composition with the closed immersion gives a surjective universally closed Z -> Z', then existing 09MQ separatedness descent and 03GN image-universally-closed yield that Z' -> S is separated, locally of finite type, universally closed, hence proper. The target image is therefore the closed subset f(Z)=Z' proper over S. Three Mathlib search kinds were recorded for each new node; no duplicate statement or tag-carrying node suitable for these exact source routes was reused.
